## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.
说明实际问题及改动后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List the relevant checks and results. For media or UI changes, include a browser check.
列出相关检查及结果；视频或界面改动请附浏览器验证。

## Compatibility and attribution / 兼容性与署名

Mention dataset/schema changes, locale updates, and any new third-party material with its license.
说明数据格式变化、双语文案更新，以及新增第三方素材的来源和许可。
